title: Poached eggs
summary: Soft white, runny yolk, no special kit.
source: Written for REMY by Claude, timers from cook-times.json (eggs). Waiting for Matthew's review.
notes: Fresh eggs hold together best. Runny yolks are a personal choice. For anyone vulnerable (pregnant, elderly, very young, unwell), cook until yolk and white are firm: see food-safety.json.
ingredients: 1 tsp vinegar (optional, helps the white set)

steps.instruction: Bring the water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar. Crack each egg into its own cup.
looks_right: small bubbles rising, the surface just trembling
looks_wrong: a rolling boil (too fierce: it tears the egg apart)

steps.instruction: Stir the water to make a gentle swirl, then tip the egg into the middle, close to the surface.
looks_right: the white wrapping around the yolk
looks_wrong: the white spreading into wispy strands (water too fierce or egg not fresh)
steps.done_when: The white is set and opaque but the yolk still wobbles when you lift it with the spoon.

steps.instruction: Lift the egg out with the slotted spoon, drain it on kitchen paper and serve on toast.
looks_right: a neat, set white with a soft yolk
looks_wrong: clear, runny white (put it back for 30 seconds)
